typicalSteps.name: Purchase Request Received
typicalSteps.description: An internal request for goods/services is submitted

typicalSteps.name: Vendor Selection
typicalSteps.description: Appropriate vendor is identified or RFQ is sent

typicalSteps.name: Purchase Order Creation
typicalSteps.description: Formal PO is created and sent to vendor

typicalSteps.name: Order Confirmation
typicalSteps.description: Vendor confirms PO and provides delivery timeline

typicalSteps.name: Goods Receipt
typicalSteps.description: Physical or digital delivery is received and verified

typicalSteps.name: Invoice Matching
typicalSteps.description: Invoice matched against PO and receipt (3-way match)

industryVariations.manufacturing: Often includes quality inspection step before goods receipt
industryVariations.services: May skip goods receipt, uses service entry sheet instead
industryVariations.retail: High volume, often automated reorder points
